title: Nitro-X
description: Vanilla+ Server dedicated modpack to pair with Nitro for the full Vanilla+ Experience
body:
Nitro-X is a **server-side** Vanilla+ modpack focused heavily on **performance** with built in quality of life intended to install in your dedicated server and then use alongside [Nitro](https://modrinth.com/modpack/nitro) on the client side for the full experience.

If you would rather only use e4mc and invite friends in single player use regular Nitro instead and nevermind this one.
